_comment: "Sharpen target sword you control" was STEAL_AURA_TOKEN -- it stole a token from the OPPONENT and sharpened nothing. A real SHARPEN effect exists. The follow-up "if IT has 1 or more +1{p} counters" is about the sword just sharpened, not about this action card, so it is REF_COUNTER_GTE on the `sharpened` ref that SHARPEN sets; COUNTER_GTE read the source card, which never carries power counters.
